answer: Rotate each session key every 50 tasks and tie the new key to a signed work receipt. Cap issuance at 4 keys per epoch per identity, so a farm cannot pre-generate a stock. Verify receipts in batches of 32 by a panel that excludes the issuer. A whisper of leaked key material dies at the next rotation, a relic of an old key buys nothing, and impersonating 1,000 agents means a separate thread of signed work for each.
